facts.fact: Congo's delegate to the Abidjan civil-status symposium of 10 to 12 December 2024, Bonsang Oko Letchaud, told Digitalmag.ci that the authorities were still drawing up the legal framework, with a new civil-status law, and that only once it is in place can Congo deploy its digitalisation system, SIFEC, which he said would be done by 2026; no office is said to use it.
facts.system: Système d'intégration des faits d'état civil (SIFEC)

facts.fact: Congo's delegate to the Abidjan symposium of 10 to 12 December 2024 described the civil status as still in a 'système mécanique' that the country would leave, with everything to be digitised by 2026, as reported by Digitalmag.ci.
